function.description: Calculate the total tip amount for a given total bill and tip percentage. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

bill_total.description: The total bill amount. This is a float type value.

tip_percentage.description: The tip percentage. This is a float type value.

split.description: Number of people the tip is split between. Default is 1.

message.content:
Los Angeles has a vibrant sushi scene, but if you’re looking for the “best” spot, many locals and critics point to **Sushi Gen** in West Hollywood as a top choice. Here’s why it stands out: | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Location** | 1120 N. Fairfax Ave., West Hollywood (close to Beverly Hills & Hollywood) | | **Ambiance** | Classic Japanese izakaya vibe with a lively bar area and a more intimate dining room. | | **Menu Highlights** | • **Omakase** – Chef’s tasting menu featuring seasonal fish and creative rolls.
• **Nigiri & Sashimi** – Fresh, high‑grade cuts from trusted suppliers.
• **Specialty Rolls** – e.g., “Gen’s Roll” (tuna, eel, avocado, cucumber). | | **Service** | Attentive, knowledgeable staff who explain each dish and recommend pairings. | | **Price Range** | $30–$70 per person for the omakase; $15–$25 for individual pieces. | | **Reviews** | Consistently 4.5–5 stars on Yelp, Google, and Zagat. | | **Why It’s Best** | • Consistent quality of fish.
• Innovative yet respectful approach to traditional sushi.
• Great value for the price, especially for the omakase experience. | ### Other Notable Options | Restaurant | Specialty | Why Mentioned | |------------|-----------|---------------| | **Sushi Park** (West Hollywood) | Omakase, Edamame | Known for its “Chef’s Choice” tasting menu and excellent service. | | **Sushi Taro** (Beverly Hills) | Traditional & modern rolls | A favorite among celebrities; offers a refined dining experience. | | **Sushi Katsu** (Hollywood) | Creative rolls, sushi burritos | Trendy, Instagram‑friendly spot with a fun atmosphere. | | **Sushi Ota** (Beverly Hills) | Omakase, sashimi | Highly praised for its fresh fish and meticulous preparation. | ### Tips for Visiting 1. **Reservations** – Book well in advance, especially for the omakase or weekend nights. 2. **Dress Code** – Casual attire is fine, but some places may have a smart‑casual policy for the dining room. 3. **Payment** – Many sushi spots accept credit cards, but it’s courteous to have cash for tips. 4. **Allergies** – Inform the server about any seafood allergies; most places can accommodate. Enjoy your sushi adventure in LA! If you’d like a reservation link or more details on a specific restaurant, just let me know.
